name: Word-by-word captions
technique: Captions from a real transcript (word-level timings): words grouped on pauses ≥150 ms, punctuation or a word limit; one group at a time, each word lighting up exactly on its spoken start, keywords turning accent and slightly larger; every group hard-killed after its last word.

text.label: Preview text (used only without a transcript)

default.sq: Po kërkon shtëpi në Tiranë? Me Shtëpia.ime filtron sipas çmimit dhe dhomave, dhe i sheh të gjitha në hartë.
default.en: Looking for a home in Tirana? With Shtëpia.ime you filter by price and rooms, and see them all on the map.
default.it: Cerchi casa a Tirana? Con Shtëpia.ime filtri per prezzo e camere, e le vedi tutte sulla mappa.
